The T7 → T8 transition. Put the §9Supermassive Seed Core§r in escrow and §9Star Chart: Milky Way§r in the slot while Triangulum burns, in galaxy mode with no companion charts in the slot bus. No fluid is buffered: bursts alone hold the merger. §9Begin§r once ready.

§5§lTHE §lMERGER§r 30 min:
- the demand ramps from 1.5 to 6 Bu/t (1.5e13 to 6e13 EU/t): bring the bursts, there is no fluid charge;
- three warned pericentre passes at 10, 20 and 30 min give W ±12 and P +5 a second for 5 s;
- then Stable for 2 min in a row within 5 min.

A failure loses Triangulum only and keeps the core. Leave the chart in: the Eye relights §9Triangulum§r at T7 from a new Magnetar Collapse charge (White and Black Dwarf Matter, with bursts on the ports), and the merger can begin again. No magnetar re-run.

[note]The core is made from 128,000 L Entangled Ergomatter, 2,304 L Magnetar Matter and Black Dwarf nanites. Its name is the hole it seeds, not the fluid.[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold the core and the chart (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL: claim before the core goes into escrow).
